_doc: Catalog-declared ambiguous names: a bare mention of one of these must hand off (ambiguous_metric_alias). Data, not code: add a term here and it is trained and enforced.

crp.spec: v1.5 3.10d: standard CRP is a different, less sensitive assay with no catalog id

calcium.spec: v1.6 10e: total serum calcium has no id; only ionized calcium exists

magnesium.spec: v1.7 10f: only RBC magnesium exists; serum is a different test

temp.spec: v1.7 10f: bare temperature is ambiguous; "temp" is its abbreviation
